request_summary: Run the full GEC DEV integration suite against the approved existing baseline, diagnose failures, and stop without fixes or reruns.

actions.description: Rechecked the approved branch and working-tree baseline, then verified Python 3.14.3, Behave 1.2.6, and the Allure formatter.
Executed the full src/integration/gec suite once in DEV; Behave completed with exit code 1, 45 of 52 scenarios passed, and 7 failed.
Reported the seven failures and artifact paths; could not persist the required existing Markdown report because the edit tool was unavailable.

outcome.detail: The run completed and its 52-case JUnit evidence was independently verified. Report persistence was incomplete in the runner task and was subsequently completed by the QA-closer.

friction.description: The runner had no file-edit tool and could not update the existing GEC error report; the orchestrator recovered by assigning report-only closure to QA-closer.
The --no-logcapture option did not make before_all and after_scenario hook logs observable, leaving those hook outcomes unverified.
